notes.text:
- Added five new item groups: "Filler", "Traps", "Coins", "Ammo" and "Health".
- Fixed Universal Tracker and the built-in client display showing incorrect information when playing with the "Progressive Catapult" setting enabled.
- Improved logic for backwards traversal of the "Code C.H.I.M.P." stage.

For instructions, see the [Setup Guide.](https://github.com/dannybonz/ae2_archipelago/blob/main/docs/setup.md)
